title: Employment Protection Act (Arizona Revised Statutes, Title 23, Chapter 9)
verified_how: Fetched the Title 23 index: 'Chapter 9: Employment Protection Act (Sec. 23-1501 to 23-1502)', Article 1 General Provisions, in the compilation updated through the 57th Legislature, 2nd Regular Session.
notes: This is the at-will statute: it codifies employment at will and limits wrongful-termination claims to the grounds it lists. Arizona has no severance entitlement and no mini-WARN Act; mass-layoff notice is federal (29 U.S.C. s 2101 et seq.). Final pay on discharge sits in ch. 2, art. 7.
